title: STruCpp
subtitle: IEC 61131-3 Structured Text to C++ compiler — npm package, CLI binaries, C++ runtime headers, VS Code extension
advisorySource: GitHub Advisory Database via osv-scanner (OSV) (equivalent to Dependabot)
_note_ids: Every triage entry lists the advisory ids it accounts for. build-report.mjs cross-checks the live post-suppression scan against these: an advisory no entry claims is reported in section 4a as untriaged.
_note_counts: advisories/counts describe the last FULL assessment (assessedAt) and are only rendered when the report is built without a live scan. With --osv-raw/--osv-delta the numbers come from that run.
headline: Initial baseline. No triage decision has been recorded yet; the figures in the Key metrics table come from the live scan of this run, and any advisory it surfaces is listed as untriaged until it is assessed.
scope: STruC++ is a TypeScript compiler from IEC 61131-3 Structured Text to C++14. It ships as an npm package, as standalone CLI binaries built with @yao-pkg/pkg, with header-only C++ runtime headers, and as a VS Code extension. This assessment covers the npm dependency graph of the compiler (package-lock.json) and of the VS Code extension (vscode-extension/package-lock.json), including development dependencies.
scopeNote: Not scanned for vulnerabilities: vendored code without a package-manager entry (isocline in src/runtime/repl, OpenSML and S7RTT in libs/sources/plcopen-softmotion, the OSCAT BASIC library archive) and the Node.js runtime embedded in the CLI binaries. They are listed in the SBOM from security/components.json.
methodologyNote: Advisory data was obtained from the GitHub Advisory Database via osv-scanner (OSV) (equivalent to GitHub Dependabot alerts). The source of truth for versions is the committed package-lock.json files. Development, build and test dependencies are included in the scan.
licenseNote: Licences of npm packages are taken from package metadata by cdxgen and listed per component in the SBOM CSV. Vendored components carry the licence stated in their vendored sources; OSCAT BASIC is recorded as NOASSERTION. No licence review has been recorded yet.
criticalNote: No critical-severity assessment has been recorded yet; see the live scan figures and section 4a.
